title: Service Manager: role permissions match the expected set
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Service Manager role.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Service Manager role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
custom_expected: The Service Manager permissions match the expected set: Work orders View/Create & Edit (no Delete); Work order lines Create & Edit/Delete; Schedule full; Customers full; Part sales full; Catalog and Inventory full; Vendor and order management full; Invoicing & payments View/Create & Edit (no Delete); Reports on; Customer portal on; See Financial Data on; View and Manage AP/AR Data on; Settings limited to App Settings and View/Manage Wages; View mode Full View.
viu_status: Roles-API-Verified (permission set matches the live role); workflow spot-checks Blocked-UI
evidence: Service Manager permission set confirmed live via GET /api/roles/{id} (roles-matrix-2026-07-13).
